newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices -March 19.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices -March 19.

text.p: (DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker prices were quoted much higher on Wednesday but buyers were scared off by the high prices and stayed out of the market, traders said. Strong cargo prices and crude values boosted sentiment, "but prices have been high enough and if they continue going up, shipowners will just buy elsewhere," said one trader.
